wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 06-005 pins the public-surface constants and function exports of the sprite-rendering pipeline (spriteProjection, spriteClip, fuzz). The read-only modules already implement R_ProjectSprite + R_SortVisSprites + R_DrawMaskedColumn + R_DrawFuzzColumn; this step's focused test asserts the vanilla constants (MAXVISSPRITES=128, FUZZ_TABLE_SIZE=50, FUZZ_COLORMAP_INDEX=6, FF_FRAMEMASK=0x7fff, FF_FULLBRIGHT=0x8000, silhouette flags 0..3, CLIP_UNSET=-2) and every export's existence + callability so later render-lane steps cannot accidentally regress the pre-pinned semantics. No source file is modified.
